SpoolId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one registered spool.
SpoolId.title: SpoolId

description:
One stretch of a file with planned colour changes, as a filament check
reads it.

color.description: Its colour as `#RRGGBB`; null when the file names none.

filament_mm.description: The filament it feeds, in millimetres.

required_g.description:
What it needs from the spool meant for it, in grams, by that spool's
diameter and density; null when no spool is there to convert with.

segment.description: Its number: segment 0 runs from the file's start to the first change.

spool_id.description:
The spool meant for it: the one on tool 0 for segment 0, and the one
the manifest names for a later segment; null when none is.

title: PreflightSegment
